column4: FAQ Q10: "No, travel insurance does not cover pregnancy."
column5: Absolute and wrong as stated. Travel policies routinely cover unforeseen pregnancy complications; what's excluded is routine pregnancy, prenatal care and childbirth. Stated as a flat No, this can lead a pregnant traveller to skip cover she's eligible for, or not claim on cover she holds.
column6: "Routine pregnancy, prenatal care and childbirth are excluded. Most policies do cover unforeseen pregnancy complications, subject to the policy wording and any pre-existing-condition terms. Airlines set their own limits - Emirates requires a medical certificate from week 29 and does not carry single pregnancies from week 37 (week 33 for multiples)." Link /travel-insurance/articles/does-travel-insurance-cover-pregnancy/. The Dubai page makes the mirror-image error - fix both in one pass.
